terra.problem: The passage does not say that every person was at a table or describe each person's feelings.
The claim that nobody was sitting in a corner with a long face adds a detail the passage does not give.
The passage says the kingdoms served Solomon, but it does not say they never fought him.
The passage does not say that nobody was plotting against Solomon.
Peace on all sides does not establish that there was no trouble at any border or that nobody brought Solomon a complaint.
Enemies on all sides are not necessarily the opposite of peace on all sides. The passage does not say whether Solomon had enemies.
David's relationship to Solomon and his status as an earlier king are facts from outside the passage and need a reference.
The passage names Nathan as the father of two officials but does not identify him as Nathan the prophet. The explanation treats them as the same person without a verse explicitly doing so.
The explanation is a flat restatement of the verse, with little of Papa Dorin's personality in a moment that could carry more.
The explanation is generic and flat, with no distinctive Papa Dorin voice in a moment that could be playful.
Saying the kings sent men to Solomon 'not the other way around' implies Solomon did not send men to kings. The passage does not say that.
Saying Solomon had a lesson for every corner of creation stretches the list of subjects in the passage.
The passage does not say how long the trips were.
